subject: Project idea: use of R on web-pages

messages.author: 7e5b409f2124fd82
messages.subject: Project idea: use of R on web-pages
parts:
Hi,
for a long time I have an idea and, I think, GSOC is a good
possibility to implement this.

Two main parts of web applications are user part (web-page) and
storage of data (DB). Often statistical work has to be done on data
and presented to a user. Simple example: average temperature at a day
on a meteorological site. Complicated example: some statistics and
graphics concerning financial time series. Usually, special business
logic is created to implement these statistical functions.

I propose to implement this in R. Separate R-functions will get data
from DB and return necessary information to the user-part. Names of
the functions will be parameters to JSTL-tags.

Advantages:
1) we can use all the huge number of R-functions without implementing
them.
2) It allows change R-code without changing other parts and even
without recompiling the application.

I know, there is a possibility to call R from Java. Interactive
graphics can be implemented in Flex.

This is the main idea. Technical details should be specified.

Has this idea future? Has anybody interest in mentoring this?
Waiting for your response.

ConstantinM
